outcome: multiple dorsal and lumbar vertebral fractures
cohort: A 34-year-old woman with a history of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and Antiphospholipid Syndrome who developed postpartum back pain.
finding: This case highlights that Pregnancy and lactation-associated osteoporosis (PLO) can occur in patients with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and Antiphospholipid Syndrome, manifesting as postpartum back pain and multiple vertebral fractures.
